ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: Sees twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight and similar conditions of poor illumination.

ability.name: Breath Weapon
ability.description: Once per day, a breath weapon dealing 6d8 points of damage; a successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the half-dragon's racial HD + the half-dragon's Con modifier) halves the damage. Shape and energy depend on the dragon variety: 60-foot line of acid (black, copper), 60-foot line of lightning (blue, bronze), 60-foot line of fire (brass), 30-foot cone of corrosive acid gas (green), 30-foot cone of fire (red, gold), or 30-foot cone of cold (white, silver).

ability.name: Dragon Variety Immunity
ability.description: Immunity to one energy type determined by the dragon variety: acid (black, green, copper), electricity (blue, bronze), fire (red, brass, gold) or cold (white, silver). The variety is not modelled as a selectable choice, so this immunity is recorded descriptively rather than applied mechanically.
